title: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (PennState)
summary: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (PennState) is a university in Altoona. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with PennState.

sections.heading: What PennState is known for
paragraphs: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (PennState) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant undergraduate enrollment of 2,367 students. PennState is particularly recognized for its strong programs in health and business, with about 24.7% of students enrolled in health-related fields and 16.2% pursuing business studies. These program shares highlight the university's focus on preparing students for careers in these vital sectors.
